instructions.en: Bar racked across the upper back, feet shoulder-width. Squat until hips drop below knee level, then drive back up.
Lying on a flat bench, lower the bar to the chest, then press it back up to full arm extension.
Bar over midfoot, hinge at the hips to grip it, then stand by driving the floor away, keeping the bar close to the shins.
Hinge forward holding the bar, pull it into the lower ribs while keeping the torso still, then lower under control.

form_cues: pull to the ribs not the neck

instructions.en: Feet shoulder-width, no load. Squat down until thighs are roughly parallel to the floor, then stand.
Walking at a purposeful, exercise pace of roughly 3.5-3.9 mph.
Rear foot elevated on a bench, front foot forward. Lower until the rear knee nearly touches the floor, then drive up through the front leg.
From standing, drop into a squat, kick the feet back to a plank, do a push-up, jump the feet back in, then jump up.

form_cues: keep a flat back in the plank

instructions.en: Lying on the back, knees bent, curl the shoulders off the floor toward the hips, then lower under control.
Lying on the back, arms up and knees bent at 90 degrees. Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor, keeping the low back pressed down, then return and switch.

form_cues: low back stays on the floor

instructions.en: Standing, dumbbells at the sides. Curl the weights toward the shoulders, then lower under control.

form_cues: elbows stay pinned to the sides

instructions.en: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand and walk a set distance keeping the torso tall and shoulders back.
Hold a dumbbell vertically at chest height. Squat between the knees, keeping the torso upright, then stand.
Sustained running at a comfortable, conversational pace.
Turn the rope with the wrists and hop over it with small, low jumps at a steady rhythm.

form_cues: turn the rope with the wrists not the arms

instructions.en: Squat down then explode upward into a jump, landing softly back into the squat position.
Hinge and hike the kettlebell back between the legs, then snap the hips forward to swing it to chest height.

form_cues: power from the hips, not the arms

instructions.en: Seated at the machine, pull the bar down to the upper chest, then let it rise back under control.
Standing, dumbbells at the sides. Raise the arms out to shoulder height, then lower under control.

form_cues: lead with the elbows not the hands

instructions.en: Seated at the machine, pad against the shins. Extend the knees to full extension, then lower under control.
Plank position. Drive the knees alternately toward the chest at a fast, running-like pace.
Bar at the shoulders, press it straight overhead to full arm extension, then lower back to the shoulders.

form_cues: ribs down, no excessive lean back
bar path stays close to the face

instructions.en: Forearms and toes on the floor, body in a straight line from head to heels. Hold the position.
Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, pull the chin above the bar, then lower under control to full arm extension.
Plank position, hands under shoulders. Lower the chest to the floor, then push back up to full arm extension.
Holding the bar, push the hips back with a slight knee bend until a stretch is felt in the hamstrings, then return to standing.
Drive with the legs, then lean back and pull the handle to the lower ribs, reversing the sequence to return.

form_cues: reverse the order on the way back

instructions.en: Sustained running at roughly a 10 minute/mile pace (6 mph).
Seated, torso leaned back slightly, feet off the floor. Rotate the torso side to side, touching the floor beside the hips.
Standing on the balls of the feet on a platform, rise up onto the toes, then lower the heels below the platform.
Facing a cable machine, elbows pinned to the sides. Push the bar down to full extension, then let it rise under control.
Step forward into a lunge until the rear knee nearly touches the floor, then drive up and step through into the next lunge.
